Our Story

More Than a Meal.Itâ€™s an Experience.

The Lavish Restaurant in Jyothinagar, Karimnagar was built around one simple idea: food that is generous, honest and worth remembering. Every biryani, mandi and grill is prepared with the care that keeps our guests coming back.

Wide tables, warm lighting and a welcoming team make it just as easy to bring the whole family as it is to celebrate something special. Come hungry â€” stay a while.
